hint: LaneTally's session-capture wrapper, expected at ~/.local/bin/claude-lanetally; set BROKKR_LANETALLY_BIN to an absolute path if ~/.local/bin is not on PATH

hands.unsupported: the LaneTally session-capture wrapper passes flags through to claude, but the pass-through of --mcp-config, --tools and --strict-mcp-config has not been measured; unsupported until it is.

identity.unknown: no wrapper measurement exists: the installed claude-lanetally has no captured version, and no LaneTally version command is invented to obtain one

wrapper-work-site.reason: a wrapper is qualified on its own wrapper, never on what it wraps; claude's captured interface says nothing about what this wrapper forwards, and support by analogy is exactly what this field refuses
limitations: unmeasured: the wrapper's identity, what it forwards to claude, how the underlying claude version is read through a measured interface, and where the ledger capture marker is attributed on a rejoin
the hands deferral above is a separate matter and is not what blocks this shape
